name: The Finders
summary:
"The Finders" is a VR game that challenges players to find objects throughout Pet-World. It’s a mini open-world game where players can explore maps, complete exciting quests, play various mini-games, hang out with other players (Coming Soon), collect objects, and level up to become the best "Finder."

Features:
・Cute animals
・Sandbox exploration
・Main quest 
・Mini-games

More features will be added every month. So, stay tuned with us!
